europe_now.title: Businesses warned of Russian sabotage
europe_now.summary: European businesses supporting Ukraine have been urged to take immediate protective measures against potential Russian sabotage operations.

europe_now.title: EU rejects Libya-Turkey maritime pact
europe_now.summary: The European Union has officially dismissed the Libya-Turkey agreement regarding potential oil drilling in Greek waters as null and void.

top_stories.title: Judicial Proceedings in France
top_stories.summary: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife Carla Bruni are set to face trial. The legal proceedings involve allegations of witness tampering.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Financial and Military Support
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the country is seeking €115 billion in foreign aid for 2027. Meanwhile, independent battlefield updates indicate that Russian military casualties have reached high levels.
